diagnosis: All 4 rollouts revealed PF1, PF2, and PF3 via reveal actions and cited all three in justification_fact_ids, so there are no disclosure or telepathy problems. The gate failed because of ENCODING MISMATCH on three content checks that validate commitment wording. C5 (linked to PF1) failed in rollouts 0, 1, and 3: the check requires the commitment to reference the 'panel work sheet,' but those rollouts wrote 'generator load test' or 'facilities binder' instead; only rollout 2 included 'work sheet' and passed. C6 (linked to PF2) failed in rollout 2: the check requires the time window '(1000-1200)' in the commitment, but rollout 2 omitted it. C7 (linked to PF3) failed in rollouts 2 and 3: the check requires both 'protected-network maintenance window' and 'signal shop ticket' in the commitment, but rollout 2 wrote 'encryption-key synchronization window' instead of 'maintenance window,' and rollout 3 collapsed all three sections into a single combined commitment that dropped both 'signal shop ticket' and the 'operations board' target.

C5.why: The exact east distribution panel outage changes the generator load-test window to 0800-1000 and requires a commitment referencing the panel work sheet.

C7.why: The exact encryption-key synchronization window changes network maintenance to 1200-1400 and requires a commitment referencing the protected-network maintenance window and signal shop ticket.

C6.why: The vaccine refrigerator requirement changes the clinic transfer window to exactly 1000-1200 and requires a commitment referencing generator-backed power during that transfer.
